title: Three-agent order desk with memory and review card
request: Build THREE agents. 'catalog' knows prices: pen 1.50, notebook 4.00, bag 25.00. 'pricing' computes the total: 10% discount if the subtotal is at least 20.00, then 8% tax on the discounted amount, rounded to 2 decimals. 'desk' is the entry agent: for 'order <qty> <product> [and <qty> <product> ...]' it asks catalog for prices and pricing for the total, remembers the pending order for that user, and replies 'Total: $<total>' with a review card titled 'Confirm order' with an Approve button (selection {"action":"confirm"}) and a Reject button (selection {"action":"cancel"}). On confirm reply 'Order confirmed: <n> items, $<total>' (n = total quantity); on cancel reply 'Order cancelled'; with no pending order reply 'No pending order'. For a product not in the catalog reply 'Unknown product: <name>'.
